paragraphs: R' Taddai. In Shabbat 38b: R' Zerika said in R' Abba's name, who said in R' Taddai's name. R' Ammi said, “R' Taddai acted for himself when he acted; the halakhah does not follow him.” R' Taddai and R' Simon in R' Yehoshua's name: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Keitzad Mevarekhin.
